steps.text: Chernobog Warehouse 12:40 A.M.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: With all these warehouses and storage equipment... this must be the warehouse district.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If we stay on this path, we'll reach the central district.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Amiya! Come look! In the warehouse.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What is it? ...Oh.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Signs of combat using sharp, blade-type Arts. Made quick work of three Reunion guys, tossed them over here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...still going.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um, I'm asking you and the medic operators to take care of the Reunion people. They may have important information.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And we've picked up Madame Ch'en's trail here...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Bloodstains. She's hurt.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There's a trail of blood here, but it stops over there. She got her bleeding under control.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Only one person left the scene. It must be Madame Ch'en.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Hold on, Madame Ch'en. We're coming...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hah... Yeah, Chernobog was just like this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But Madame Ch'en was able to take on a rogue Reunion team all by herself back there...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This time, it's totally different.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We had a cooperation agreement then, nothing else. I was only starting to learn who Madame Ch'en was...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But here, we're already...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is that... a civilian?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...Where did she come from? We haven't found their hideout...
This is an Ursus graveyard!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Stay alert... but hold your fire!)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're a neutral group researching the Infected! Ma'am,  we're here to help you!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We mean you no harm, you're a regular Infected—
Infected? Pfah! I'm Ursus!

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: You want to help the Infected...?! Hah, bullshit... Don't you know what you Infected have done to us?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ma'am, we'll keep our distance if you feel unsafe. We'll stay twenty meters back.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: No, no, I'm Infected too. So I'm not supposed to talk to you like that, right?

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: You'll save the Infected? Ahaha, hahaha... All Infected should all just die!

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: I should die too. I should die too! If there were no Infected, I wouldn't have gotten Infected!

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: All they think about is revenge and hurting others... Is THAT what the Infected do? Is that what I should be doing?!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: (Amiya, comfort her, okay?)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (No. Not now.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Let her vent. All the painful memories she's built up over the last month are stabbing into her consciousness.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (It's time she... faces them. This is a chance for her to pull them all out.)

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Do you know who we are here, Infected?

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Infected, just like you. Alive and dead.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: The Infected who managed to just barely keep themselves alive, thanks to Reunion; and the countless Infected who died here, thanks to Reunion...

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: But we weren't Infected before.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: They scattered the people of Chernobog in all directions, then hunted us down. It started as a slaughter, then turned to torture, and finally they dumped the survivors like trash!

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: I don't even know how many starved or froze to death...

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: But those of us who survived were all Infected by constant exposure to Originium! Every last one of us!

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: You Infected...

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: You damn Infected...!!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Trust us... You don't have to take us to the other patients. We'll leave you what you need for critical care. And then we're gone.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: I don't trust you.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Did Ursus send you? Or Lungmen?
If it really was them, we'd be dead already.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's you...!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, scan his ID code.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit...?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Guard, explain yourself.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: It's been a while, Amiya, Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: And, Dr. {@nickname}.
